cohort: 300 pregnant women (100 with PGMO, 100 with EGWG, and 100 healthy controls) with diet-controlled gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
finding: Mothers with EGWG during GDM-complicated pregnancy experienced a higher perinatal risk, including lower FW/PW ratio, increased cesarean section rates, and more frequent extended postpartum hospital stays due to neonate complications like jaundice, compared to those with PGMO.
mod_finding: The percentage of births completed by cesarean section was higher in the EGWG group (47%) compared to PGMO (32%) and controls (18%), primarily due to FW-related indications.
